card.statement:
The same comments as in Remark 5.8 apply here also.

In view of this fact, as in Section 5, for any $\mu\in X_{*}(T)$ we denote by

$\mathsf{F}_{\mu}:\mathrm{P}_{\mathscr{S}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})\to{\mathord{\mathrm{Mod}}}_{\mathbf{k}}$

the functor defined by

$\mathsf{F}_{\mu}(\mathscr{A})=\mathsf{H}^{\langle 2\rho,\mu\rangle}_{T_{\mu}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathscr{A})\cong\mathsf{H}^{\langle 2\rho,\mu\rangle}_{c}(S_{\mu},\mathscr{A}).$
card.label: Remark 10.2

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
